t: You're standing at Flat Time House, on Bellenden Road in South London. It was the studio home of the British conceptual artist John Latham, who lived here. Latham was born in Northern Rhodesia and lived from 1921 to 2006. Today the house is open as a contemporary art gallery, a centre for alternative learning and an artist residency space. It also holds the John Latham archive. It's a registered charity, so the home of one artist now works as a place for others to make and learn.
